content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently overestimate prices, showing upward bias with no mean-reversion in early periods.", "Sentiment signals are weak or absent, leading to model drift without behavioral correction.", "Forecast accuracy declines as price drops below historical mean, indicating lag in model adaptation.", "Model forecasts exhibit diminishing sensitivity to recent sentiment shifts, especially when sentiment is neutral.", "Forecast overshoots are most pronounced in early 30-day windows, suggesting overconfidence in trend continuation.", "True outcomes show strong downward momentum after initial peaks, indicating model failure to capture volatility reversal.", "Model calibration should incorporate recent price lows and sentiment polarity to reduce forecast bias.", "Forecasting should adjust for sentiment-driven corrections, especially when sentiment turns negative or neutral."]}
